<details>
<summary>Single treatments: for each size connected vs unconnected</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.height = (figures_height_rmd_output * 0.7)}

# --- PLOT SINGLE REPLICATES, FOR EACH SIZE A PLOT --- #

fixed_label
plot.ecosystems.sizes.one.by.one(filtered_data,
                                 trophy_selected,
                                 disturbance_percentage_selected = "fixed",
                                 response_variable_selected)

relative_label
plot.ecosystems.sizes.one.by.one(filtered_data,
                                 trophy_selected,
                                 disturbance_percentage_selected = "decreasing_with_size",
                                 response_variable_selected)
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>A plot per ecosystem size, single replicates </summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.height = (figures_height_rmd_output * 0.7)}

# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA MEAN ± 95 % CI WITH ONE PLOT PER ECOSYSTEM SIZE --- #

for(trophy_selected in c("autotrophic", "heterotrophic")) {
  
  if(trophy_selected == "autotrophic" & response_variable_selected == "evenness_pielou"){
    next
  }
  
  trophy_selected
  
  fixed_label
  plot.ecos.sizes.one.by.one.replicates(ds_ecosystems,
                                        trophy_selected,
                                        disturbance_percentage_selected = "fixed",
                                        response_variable_selected)
  
  relative_label
  plot.ecos.sizes.one.by.one.replicates(ds_ecosystems,
                                        trophy_selected,
                                        disturbance_percentage_selected = "decreasing_with_size",
                                        response_variable_selected)
}
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Effect sizes using Hedge's d</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.height = (figures_height_rmd_output * 0.7)}

# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA EFFECT SIZES (HEDGE'S D) --- #

for(trophy_selected in c("autotrophic", "heterotrophic")) {
  
  if(trophy_selected == "autotrophic" & response_variable_selected == "evenness_pielou"){
    next
  }
  
  ggarrange(plot.ecosystems.points.ES(ds_ecosystems_effect_size,
                                    trophy_selected,
                                    "fixed",
                                    paste0(response_variable_selected, "_d")) +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis),
          NULL,
          plot.ecosystems.points.ES(ds_ecosystems_effect_size,
                                    trophy_selected,
                                    "decreasing_with_size",
                                    paste0(response_variable_selected, "_d"))  +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none"),
          heights = c(1, 0.1, 0.8),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v",
          labels = c(fixed_label, "", relative_label),
          label.x = c(0.01, 0, -0.083),
          label.y = c(0.760, 0, 0.96)) %>%
  print()

  }
```
</details>
